text_zh: 百度地图公开场馆列表中，浙江临海市的台州府城墙主记录将全年开放星期列为周一至周日；本条据该平台资料记录普通每周无固定闭园日。这是商业地图资料，不是景区新公告，未标商户资料更新时间；临时管控、维修和具体路段是否通行仍应行前核对景区通知，不保证每段城墙或当天均可进入。另据去哪儿页面所列有效期为2026-11-12至2026-12-31的提示，兴善门瓮城段局部封闭施工；这是平台提示，出发前请核景区当日公告，不冒园方原通告。本条不含同名城墙博物馆、梅园、单个城门的独立开放规则及整个府城文化旅游区的其他设施。普通入园预约是否必需及提前窗口尚未核定，不能把有售票渠道或免费当作免预约。
text_en: Baidu Maps’ public venue listing identifies the main Taizhou Prefecture City Wall entry in Linhai, Zhejiang, with Monday-to-Sunday opening throughout the year. This entry uses that platform listing for no fixed ordinary weekly closure. It is commercial map information, rather than a new attraction notice, and has no venue-data update date. Check attraction notices for temporary controls, maintenance and which sections are accessible; entry on a particular day or to every section is not guaranteed. A Qunar notice, with a listed validity period of 2026-11-12 to 2026-12-31, reports a partial construction closure at the Xingshan Gate barbican. This is a platform notice; check the attraction’s current announcements before traveling. This record excludes the similarly named wall museum, Mei Garden, separate admission rules for individual gates and other facilities in the wider cultural tourism area. Mandatory reservations and advance booking windows remain unconfirmed; ticketing channels or free admission do not establish a reservation exemption.
